# glinet_repeater (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet repeater settings. The upstream network itself is joined through the stock scan and connect flow.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto` (Boolean) Automatically reconnect to a known network.
- `blacklist_timeout` (Number) Seconds a failed network stays blacklisted.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `ip_wait_time` (Number) Seconds to wait for an address.
- `level` (Number) Signal level threshold.
- `macaddr` (String) Repeater MAC address override.
- `smart_reconnect` (Boolean) Reconnect to the best known network.
- `switch_interval` (Number) Seconds between uplink switches.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
